title: BJP protests against Congress president's remarks in Shimla
seoTitle: Shimla BJP protest against Congress remarks

tea.why: Protesters demonstrated against alleged objectionable remarks made by Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge about the Prime Minister's late father.
tea.want: Protesters demanded political restraint, warning of nationwide demonstrations if Congress leaders continue similar language against the Prime Minister and his…
tea.changed: Oct 26: BJP staged a demonstration outside the Deputy Commissioner's office in Shimla, resulting in a scuffle with police during an effigy burning.

summary: On October 26, 2026, members of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) gathered outside the Deputy Commissioner's office in Shimla to protest against comments made by Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge regarding the Prime Minister's late father. According to the sources, the demonstration involved a scuffle between police officers and party workers when the protesters attempted to burn an effigy of Kharge. BJP Rajya Sabha MP Sikander Kumar addressed reporters following the event, condemning the remarks as contrary to cultural values and warning of broader nationwide protests if the rhetoric continues. Speakers also criticized the Congress party's stance on electoral roll revisions and its planned upcoming rally in Delhi.
demands: Political restraint from Congress leaders regarding personal remarks about the Prime Minister and his family
response: Police attempted to prevent protesters from burning an effigy of the Congress president, which led to a scuffle outside the Deputy Commissioner's office, though protesters eventually managed to burn it.

updates.text: The BJP held a protest outside the Deputy Commissioner's office in Shimla, leading to a scuffle with police during an effigy burning.
